_note: Single source of truth for the vehicle picker. Route numbers mirror VEHICLES in vehicle-router.js. assumed=true means a team assumption for the demo, not an official NASA figure.

vehicles.name: On foot
vehicles.tagline: Walk in suits from the habitat
vehicles.why: Current Marswalk mode: slowest, but reaches any slope up to 15°.

vehicles.name: NASA MRV
facts: Top speed on Earth about 40 mph (NASA)
vehicles.why: Fast, but the crew stays in suits and must be able to walk home if it breaks down.

vehicles.name: NASA SEV
vehicles.tagline: Pressurised rover for trips up to 14 days
facts: Pressurised cabin, no suits while driving
vehicles.why: Climbs the steepest ground and goes farthest; suits only for stops.

vehicles.name: NASA Mars Rover
vehicles.tagline: Mobile lab for a crew of four
vehicles.why: Long and heavy: prefers gentle, straight paths, but brings the lab to the outcrop.
